cause: IntrinsicHeight aliases an unconstrained wrapper instead of tightening only the child height.
evidence: Frame 0: Flutter probed row is 800 px wide; Incular is 80 px. Source: IntrinsicHeight converts to UnconstrainedBox (sizing_constraints.rs:486-490), which removes width constraints.
fix_direction: Tighten only the child height to its max intrinsic height and keep incoming width constraints.
impact: A default max-sized Row inside IntrinsicHeight shrinks to content width in Incular, moving its children.
limitations: Frame 0 of one configuration; reproduced at HEAD a19bf487.
title: IntrinsicHeight removes horizontal constraints
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: OverflowBox has no alignment and the layout path hard-codes a zero child offset.
evidence: Frame 0: a 150x110 child in a 100x80 OverflowBox is centered in Flutter and starts at the parent origin in Incular. Source: core.rs:171 returns ChildOffsets::One(Offset::ZERO); there is no alignment field.
fix_direction: Add an alignment defaulting to center and place the child by the alignment delta between parent and child sizes.
impact: Intentionally overflowing children shift by half the overflow on each axis.
limitations: One overflow case. The same zero offset drives UnconstrainedBox (layout-004).
title: OverflowBox lacks Flutter's centered child alignment
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Likely an Inter baseline metric difference in the text engine, not flex placement.
evidence: Frame 0: widths agree; the 12 px child top is 11.625 in Flutter and 11 in Incular. The 24 px child agrees. layout__baseline__without_baseline_child matches.
fix_direction: Compare Flutter and Incular Inter baseline metrics at 12 px and reconcile with the text package.
impact: Sub-pixel vertical shift in baseline-aligned rows with fractional font metrics.
limitations: One size pair; the text metric consolidation is open.
title: Baseline-aligned small text is shifted by 0.625 px
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: The Unconstrained render kind has no alignment and always returns a zero child offset.
evidence: Frame 0: sizes match on all three variants, including the overflowing ub_h height (260) and ub_v width (400). Placement differs: Flutter centers the child (ub_h y=-30, ub_v x=200, ub_none y=370) while Incular places it at 0 (250, 400 for ub_none). Source: core.rs:199 returns ChildOffsets::One(Offset::ZERO); the render kind has no alignment.
fix_direction: Add alignment (default center) to UnconstrainedBox and place the child with alignment.within on the box size, allowing negative offsets.
flutter_ref: widgets/basic.dart:3117-3180 (UnconstrainedBox alignment and constrainedAxis); widgets/basic.dart:2949-2969 (widthUnconstrained, heightUnconstrained)
impact: UnconstrainedBox children that differ from the box size are placed at top-left, not centered (Flutter default alignment).
limitations: Verified on frame 0 for overflowing children. The smaller-child case is by reading of core.rs:199 and was not frame-tested. The Flutter twin uses clipBehavior hardEdge to avoid the overflow error; the Incular twin has no clip, which does not affect geometry.
title: UnconstrainedBox ignores alignment; overflowing children stay at top-left
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: Incular Table is intrinsic-only; layout_table takes the maximum child width per column (algorithms.rs:813).
evidence: Non-equivalent diagnostic: the Incular twin is the only available Incular table (max-content columns) with the same children. Flutter default flex columns fill the 800 px root; Incular sizes to content (100 px). The intrinsic configuration matches (layout__table__rows_and_columns). rg found no column-width or vertical-alignment type in Incular.
fix_direction: Add a column width spec (default flex 1) and a top vertical alignment default, then implement Fixed, Flex, Fraction, Intrinsic, Min and Max with Flutter distribution rules.
flutter_ref: widgets/table.dart:104-124 (defaultColumnWidth defaults to FlexColumnWidth); rendering/table.dart:43-361 (TableColumnWidth, Fixed, Flex, Intrinsic, Min, Max, TableCellVerticalAlignment)
impact: A default Flutter Table stretches across available width. The Incular Table shrinks to content and cannot express fixed, flex, fraction or min/max column widths or cell vertical alignment.
limitations: Flex default is evidenced by a diagnostic twin only. Vertical alignment and table borders are not frame-tested.
title: Table has no column width or vertical alignment API; default columns differ from Flutter
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

cause: The intersection helper exists only as a private function in incular-layout.
evidence: The Incular twin has no enforce call and records no value; Flutter returns 100. ConstrainedBox uses the private enforce_constraints internally, so rendering is not affected.
fix_direction: Expose a public enforce on Constraints in incular-config with Flutter clamp semantics.
impact: API-shape only: callers cannot intersect two BoxConstraints through the public API. No runtime layout failure is claimed.
limitations: The other helper values in the scenario (constrain, loosen, tighten, deflate, biggest, smallest, bounded) match at frame 0.
title: No public BoxConstraints.enforce helper
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: FractionallySizedBox drops the parent minimum on an axis without a factor
evidence: Under a tight 200x100 parent, FractionallySizedBox(heightFactor: 0.5) with a 50x20 SizedBox child: Flutter passes width min=max=200 (parent constraints kept for the null widthFactor), so the child is 200x50; Incular passes width 0..200, so the child keeps its 50 px width (50x50).
impact: A FractionallySizedBox that sets only one factor lets its child shrink on the other axis where Flutter forces the parent's minimum, so children inside tight slots (Expanded, SizedBox, grid tiles) render narrower or shorter than in Flutter.
cause: fractional_constraints uses 0 as the minimum when a factor is absent instead of the parent's minimum.
fix_direction: For an axis without a factor, keep both the parent's minimum and maximum; for an axis with a factor, use the factored size as both.
limitations: Found by the orchestrator from a sweep candidate; one tight-parent case was compared. The negative-factor clamp (setter clamps to 0 where Flutter asserts) was not compared.
